name: ml-model-serving
description: Use when the user asks to serve a PyTorch model with batching and autoscaling, BentoML, Ray Serve, KServe, Triton Inference Server, Seldon, canary or A/B model rollout, model versioning and rollback. Produces serving framework choice, deployment config and rollback procedure. Not for LLM engine tuning (use ml-inference-optimization) or TensorRT engines (use tensorrt-optimization).
